skills.name: hyperframes-animation
skills.purpose: All animation knowledge for HyperFrames: atomic motion rules, multi-phase scene blueprints, transitions, 24 named text effects and adapters for GSAP, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, CSS, WAAPI and TypeGPU, all seek-safe for rendering.
skills.how_to_use: Loaded for any motion task inside a HyperFrames video; needs the HyperFrames CLI to render.
skills.evidence: Official HeyGen; skills.sh ~624K installs; #12 on skills.sh trending

skills.name: review-animations
skills.purpose: Reviews animation and motion code against Emil Kowalski's design-engineering craft bar (purpose, easing, duration, interruptibility, reduced motion); defaults to flagging issues.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke on a diff or component with motion; no prerequisites.

skills.name: animate
skills.purpose: Builds an animation from scratch by deciding in order: whether to animate, purpose, tool, properties, curve/duration, interruption and exit; then writes the implementation.
skills.how_to_use: Use when asked to animate something or add a transition; works with CSS, Motion, WAAPI etc.

skills.name: improve-animations
skills.purpose: Read-only senior motion audit of a whole codebase that outputs a prioritised list and self-contained implementation plans for other agents to execute.
skills.how_to_use: Ask to 'audit/improve the animations'; no prerequisites.

skills.name: find-animation-opportunities
skills.purpose: Read-only sweep of a codebase/UI for places that should animate (and those that should not), proposing motion with exact durations, curves and properties.
skills.how_to_use: Ask 'what could be animated here?' or 'make this feel more alive'; pairs with animate/improve-animations from the same pack.
skills.evidence: Emil Kowalski pack; skills.sh ~152K installs (higher than animate, already listed).

skills.name: gsap-core
skills.purpose: Official GSAP skill for the core API: to/from/fromTo, easing, stagger, defaults, matchMedia for responsive and reduced-motion animation.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on JS animation requests or GSAP usage; install with `npx skills add greensock/gsap-skills`.

skills.name: gsap-scrolltrigger
skills.purpose: Official GSAP ScrollTrigger skill: scroll-linked animation, pinning, scrub, snapping and parallax patterns.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on scroll animation / parallax / pinned sections.

skills.name: gsap-plugins
skills.purpose: Official GSAP guide to plugins: registration, Flip, Draggable/Inertia, Observer, ScrollSmoother/ScrollTo, SplitText/ScrambleText, DrawSVG/MorphSVG/MotionPath, CustomEase family, GSDevTools.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when using any GSAP plugin; `npx skills add greensock/gsap-skills`.
skills.evidence: Official GreenSock; skills.sh ~56K installs; largest skill in the pack (~21KB).

skills.name: gsap-react
skills.purpose: Official GSAP patterns for React/Next.js: useGSAP hook, refs, gsap.context() scoping, cleanup on unmount, SSR pitfalls.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on GSAP in React/Next.js; `npx skills add greensock/gsap-skills`.

skills.name: gsap-timeline
skills.purpose: Official GSAP timeline skill: gsap.timeline(), position parameter, nesting, labels and playback control for choreographed multi-step sequences.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on animation sequencing/choreography questions.

skills.name: animation-vocabulary
skills.purpose: Reverse-lookup glossary turning vague motion descriptions into exact terms (e.g. 'bouncy popover' -> pop in, 'iOS rubber band' -> rubber-banding) for better prompting.
skills.how_to_use: Ask 'what's it called when...'; no prerequisites.

skills.name: motion-graphics
skills.purpose: Short design-led motion graphics where motion is the message: kinetic typography, stat count-ups, chart hits, logo stings, lower-thirds, animated maps and UI animations, rendered to MP4 or transparent overlay.
skills.how_to_use: Use for <30s unnarrated motion pieces; needs HyperFrames CLI.

skills.name: hyperframes-keyframes
skills.purpose: Seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes for HyperFrames: punch-ins, zooms, reframes, Ken Burns, camera moves and match or whip hand-offs, with GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, WAAPI or FLIP.
skills.how_to_use: Use when a video composition needs camera moves or keyframed reframes that must render the same on every seek.
skills.evidence: Part of the official HyperFrames skill family (heygen-com/hyperframes); the hyperframes router skill sends work here. Found in soorajplankuveedu/claude-knowledge-backup (vendor copy) on 3 Oct 2026; installed from upstream.

skills.name: figma-implement-motion
skills.purpose: Translates Figma motion/animation data (via the Figma MCP get_motion_context) into production animation code.
skills.how_to_use: Use with the Figma MCP server when a Figma node is animated or the user says 'implement this motion'.
skills.notes: Repo has no license file -> link-only. Requires Figma MCP server.

skills.name: vercel-react-view-transitions
skills.purpose: Guide to React's View Transition API (<ViewTransition>, addTransitionType, CSS pseudo-elements) for page transitions, shared-element morphs, list reorder and enter/exit animation.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on route/page transition work in React/Next.js.
skills.notes: README states MIT but no LICENSE file.

skills.name: text-to-lottie
skills.purpose: Creates, edits and fixes Lottie/Bodymovin JSON animations (logo/type animation, loaders, icons, lower thirds, data animation) previewed in a local Skia Skottie player.
skills.how_to_use: Use for any Lottie request; repo provides the local player/tooling.
skills.evidence: 5.5k stars; skills.sh ~9.9K installs; top of awesome-claude-video-skills motion list

skills.name: scroll-scrubbed-visual-sequence
skills.purpose: Builds reversible scroll-controlled visual sequences with a pinned/sticky stage and normalized progress, rendering via video, image sequence, canvas, SVG or DOM.
skills.how_to_use: Use for scroll-scrubbed hero films, product assembly or photo sequences that play forward/back with native scroll; has REFERENCES.md and a demo.
skills.evidence: Meng To (Design+Code) skills repo, 6.6k stars; the generic public counterpart of a scroll-scrubbed cinematic hero.
skills.notes: mengto/skills was in sources_checked but none of its skills were listed.

skills.name: cinematic-scroll-storytelling
skills.purpose: Cinematic scroll-driven landing pages with Lenis + GSAP ScrollTrigger: staggered text reveals, sticky card stacks, parallax, scroll-scrubbed transitions, preloaders.
skills.how_to_use: Use when building or analysing premium editorial scroll experiences.

skills.name: pixel2motion
skills.purpose: Turns a raster logo into a clean SVG (edge-smoothness gate, IoU-optimised) and then a choreographed logo animation applying Disney's 12 principles, delivered as HTML plus GIF/video previews.
skills.how_to_use: Ask to animate a logo / build a logo reveal or splash; needs Node/Python tooling from the repo.

skills.name: motion-design
skills.purpose: LottieFiles' motion-design principles skill: timing, easing, choreography and Disney principles adapted to UI, applicable to CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Lottie or springs.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on animation/transition/micro-interaction work.

skills.name: design-motion-principles
skills.purpose: Motion/interaction expert based on Emil Kowalski, Jakub Krehel and Jhey Tompkins: build mode for purposeful component motion and audit mode that flags AI-slop motion with an HTML report.
skills.how_to_use: Use when creating or reviewing UI motion.

skills.name: manim-video
skills.purpose: Production pipeline for 3Blue1Brown-style Manim CE animations: math explainers, algorithm walkthroughs, equation derivations, with scene planning, rendering and troubleshooting references.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on math/technical animation requests; needs Python, Manim CE, LaTeX and ffmpeg.
skills.evidence: Nous Research Hermes Agent (250k stars); same skill adopted by browser-use/video-use; skills.sh ~400 installs

skills.name: slack-gif-creator
skills.purpose: Anthropic's skill for creating animated GIFs under Slack's size/dimension constraints, with validation tools and animation concepts.
skills.how_to_use: Ask 'make me a GIF of X for Slack'; uses bundled Python (Pillow).

skills.name: manimce-best-practices
skills.purpose: Best practices for Manim Community Edition: scene structure, animations, MathTex, 3D scenes, camera control, styling and CLI (with a sibling ManimGL skill and a manim-composer planner).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on `from manim import *` or Manim CLI usage; needs Manim CE.

skills.name: anidoodle
skills.purpose: Code-drawn stills, drawing timelapses, films, explainers and interactive web animations in 31 styles with composed scores; matches reference styles and keeps characters consistent, no generated assets.

skills.name: animate-expo
skills.purpose: Builds animations in React Native/Expo: thread choice, properties, spring vs timing, gesture hand-off and degradation, implemented with Reanimated, Gesture Handler, Expo Router and haptics.
